formattedAddress: 110, Taiwan, Taipei City, Xinyi District, Xicun Village, Songren Rd, 58號 號B3

text.text: Loved the half oat half milk latte (although it didn’t really taste like oat milk). I wanted to try their cookies, but they didn’t have any available. I probably wouldn’t order the biscuit again. It wasn’t the texture I was looking for. It tasted a bit stale, and instead of being soft/light and fluffy, it was more like a dried cake.

text.text:
Fikka Fikka coffee probably has one of the best coffee's I've tried in Taipei.  It is very smooth drinking coffee.  My wife and I both had a cappuccino and it was delicious.  my only complaint is that the cappuccino is really small.  I would probably need to drink 2-3 of them to satisfy my coffee craving :)

The coffee is delicious but I felt like the people working there were not very happy to be making coffee.  You not a single smile the whole time I was there (from anyone on the team).  The other Fikka Fikka that I went to, the people were very friendly.

text.text:
Coffee was actually really really good and smooth, tasted amazing. Me and my husband ordered 1 coffee and 1 ice cream but were told ice cream did not count as a drink so we had to order another drink on top of the coffee and ice cream 🙈🙈🙈

I don't know if it's Taiwan's business culture like that or just specifically this one shop. I come from SG and despite being an expensive country, no business will tell you how much you have to order. And also, I did order 2 items hahaha... Well at least the coffee was amazing. We stayed at Le Meridien across the street. And although I would love to drink another cup of coffee again from here for the sake of good taste, but the experience today makes me have to reconsider ever coming back again. Will try Simple Kaffa as recommended by my friend instead :)
